scripts.predev: pnpm -F @app/db build && pnpm -F worker build && pnpm -F web build
scripts.dev:fast: echo 'skipping predev — assumes web/worker/db are already built' && tsc -p tsconfig.json && electron dist/main.js
scripts.prepack:all: pnpm -F web build && pnpm -F worker build && pnpm -F @app/db build && node ./scripts/stage-resources.mjs
